messages:
Oliver: Heads-up — compliance rolled a privnet egress rule in ap-south1 at ~05:12. Since then we're seeing GPU node boot failures and a NATGW cost spike. Anyone oncall?
Sam: I'm seeing KMS decrypt errors during node init: "error=DecryptFailed context=init volume". Several nodes fail to complete bootstrap.
Marta: That was my change to force audit traffic through the collector endpoint. I thought endpoints were updated. Did we miss an S3 policy?
Raj: Conntrack is spiking on warm-pool hosts (showing ~80k entries), kubelet probes timing out, pod scheduling delayed. Looks like a network backpressure issue, not just KMS.
Oliver: Relevant snippets from node logs: ```
[2026-03-20T05:23:11Z] kms: decrypt timeout=10000ms err=ContextDeadlineExceeded
kubelet: pulling image failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
```
deploy-bot: [policy-change] privnet-egress/ap-south1 applied by Marta at 2026-03-20T05:12Z
Sam: Hypothesis: endpoint policy is denying S3 PutObject for the audit-forwarder -> forwarder falls back to public S3 -> traffic egresses via NATGW (cost) AND KMS requests that normally go over privatelink are hitting public KMS path and getting throttled/timeouts.
Nicole: Finance saw a ~$12k/day NATGW bump starting 05:15. We need a rapid mitigation to stop bleeding.
Marta: I'm reverting the firewall rule now and will open a targeted allow for the audit-forwarder role to the collector endpoint.
Oliver: Quick mitigation checklist (feel free to copy):
- rollback privnet egress rule (Marta)
- add endpoint policy to allow logs/audit S3 endpoints from the audit-forwarder role
- bump conntrack on warm-pool hosts: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000`
- drain failing warm nodes and replace with healthy ones
Raj: Draining and replacement in progress for 3 nodes. Also increasing nf_conntrack on current warm-pool.
Sam: After rollback, KMS decrypt latency dropped back to normal and bootstrap success rate is improving. Will watch for regressions.
Marta: Reverted. deploy-bot: [policy-rollback] privnet-egress/ap-south1 by Marta at 2026-03-20T05:46Z :thumbsup:
Oliver: Thanks — follow-ups: create an alert for KMS decrypt error rate spikes (>=5% over 5m) and a NATGW cost alarm for sudden % increase. Assign to Sam + Nicole.
Nicole: I'll set up a budget alert and add tagging for audit-forwarder egress so future spikes are attributable.
Sam: I'll file a short postmortem and link runbook changes: https://docs.internal/pm/4740001234-audit-egress-rollback
Raj: Adding conntrack tuning and warm-pool validation to the warm-pool runbook.
Oliver: OK closing thread unless new errors surface. Thanks all.
